newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal to study foreign investment plans - paper.
newsitem.headline: Portugal to study foreign investment plans - paper.

text.p: Economy Minister Augusto Mateus will propose two foreign investment projects worth a total of at least 12 billion escudos ($80 million) for the approval of the Portuguese cabinet this month, a Lisbon newspaper reported.

Mateus told Diario Economico the projects included a joint venture between Ford Motor Co and the South Korean Halla Group to build a car components factory, and a plan by German company Grohe to build a tap factory.
The paper said the Socialist government was considering providing financial and tax incentives for the projects.
The six billion escudo car components factory was expected to be located in the Palmela industrial park, 18 miles (30 km) south of Lisbon, Diario Economico said.
Grohe's proposed six billion escudo factory, due to start producing taps for export in 1998, should be established in Albergaria-A-Velha near Aveiro in north Portugal, it said.
